name: DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide) (DS) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 3 pack sizes: 2 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Testing for DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide): HPLC purity against ≥99.0% (HPLC), MS confirmation of the intact mass, and a documented identity record (CAS 62568-57-4, formula C35H48N10O15, 848.8 Da). Results are reported per lot, not as a catalogue average.

faq.question: How should DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide) be stored?
faq.answer: Hold the sealed 10-vial kit at −20 °C, away from light and humidity. Once reconstituted, aliquot and keep at 2–8 °C; this DS preparation does not tolerate repeated freeze–thaw.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide)?
faq.answer: DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide) is stocked in 3 pack sizes (2 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $29.24; 10–49 kits falls to $26.90 (−8%) and 50+ to $24.86 (−15%).
